# Vendored NVIDIA Sol-Attn

The `sol_attn` directory is copied from the `sol-engine` branch of
`NVlabs/Sana` at commit `d0c0a4685ab5dc2336d18b7213d85f13def92418`.

The upstream README declares repository code under Apache-2.0. The full
Apache-2.0 license is included as `LICENSE.NVIDIA-Sana-Apache-2.0`; upstream
third-party notices and the FlashAttention BSD-3-Clause license remain in the
vendored source tree.
